title: 25 Thanksgiving Corporate Gifts for Clients & Employees
summary: Discover 25 Thanksgiving corporate gifts for clients and employees, from gourmet treats to premium apparel, with thoughtful ideas for every budget.
body_markdown:
Thanksgiving is the perfect opportunity to show a little extra appreciation, and these thoughtful Thanksgiving corporate gifts can help you do just that. Whether you're thanking loyal clients, recognizing hardworking employees, or celebrating another successful year, the right gift can make a lasting impression.


From gourmet treats and cozy fall essentials to premium drinkware and personalized accessories, there are plenty of ways to express your gratitude without waiting for the December holiday rush.


To make shopping easier, we've rounded up 25 Thanksgiving gift ideas for clients and employees, with options for different budgets, preferences, and gifting needs. Whether you're ordering for a handful of VIP clients or your entire team, you'll find practical, memorable gifts that help you say thanks in style.


## How to Choose Thanksgiving Corporate Gifts


Choosing the right Thanksgiving corporate gifts starts with knowing your recipients and finding something they'll genuinely enjoy. A thoughtful gift doesn't have to be expensive, but it should feel personal, useful, and appropriate for the occasion.


Here are a few things to consider when selecting gifts for clients and employees:


-


**Consider your recipients.** A longtime client might appreciate a premium gift, while employees may enjoy practical items they can use at home or work.


-


**Set a realistic budget.** Factor in the number of recipients, customization costs, packaging, and shipping to find options that fit your budget.


-


**Embrace the season.** Cozy blankets, warm drinkware, and gourmet treats capture the spirit of fall without relying on Thanksgiving-specific designs.


-


**Keep branding tasteful.** Subtle logos, personalized packaging, and thoughtful touches make gifts feel more meaningful and less promotional.


-


**Delivery Plan.** Consider production timelines, shipping destinations, and whether perishable items will arrive fresh, especially when sending gifts to remote employees or clients.


For more inspiration, explore our[corporate gifting ideas](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/corporate-gifts) for every occasion.

## When to Send Thanksgiving Corporate Gifts


The best time to send Thanksgiving corporate gifts is typically the week before Thanksgiving or early in Thanksgiving week. This gives recipients time to enjoy their gifts before the holiday and helps your gesture stand out from the December gifting rush.


****


If you're ordering customized merchandise, be sure to factor in production, personalization, and shipping timelines. For last-minute orders, check available options with your gifting partner before promising a delivery date. And if Thanksgiving arrives before your gifts do, a thoughtful end-of-year appreciation gift is always a welcome alternative.


****

## FAQs


### What are good Thanksgiving gifts for clients?


Good Thanksgiving gifts for clients include gourmet chocolates, artisan cookies, premium drinkware, cozy blankets, and elegant home accessories. Consider the nature of your client relationships and choose gifts that feel thoughtful without being overly promotional. Personalized packaging or a handwritten thank-you note can make even a simple gift feel special.


****


### What are good Thanksgiving gifts for employees?


The best Thanksgiving employee appreciation gifts include branded hoodies, insulated mugs, travel accessories, gourmet treats, and wireless headphones. Practical gifts that employees can enjoy at work or home are especially appealing. Choose items that reflect your team's interests and add subtle company branding for a personalized touch.


****


### How much should a company spend on Thanksgiving gifts?


Thanksgiving corporate gift budgets vary depending on the recipient and your company's gifting goals. Small appreciation gifts can cost under $25, while midrange options typically fall between $25 and $100. Premium gifts for valued clients or employee recognition programs may exceed $100. Remember to account for customization, packaging, and shipping costs.


****


### Can Thanksgiving corporate gifts be customized?


Absolutely! Thanksgiving corporate gifts can be personalized with company logos, custom packaging, branded gift cards, and other thoughtful details. From subtle branding on premium drinkware to embroidered apparel, customization makes your gifts feel more personal while keeping your brand top of mind.


****


### When should you send Thanksgiving corporate gifts?


Ideally, Thanksgiving corporate gifts should arrive during the week before Thanksgiving or early in Thanksgiving week. For customized merchandise, allow additional time for production, packaging, and shipping. If you've missed the Thanksgiving delivery window, consider sending an end-of-year appreciation gift instead. Explore our[corporate holiday gifts for clients](https://www.gemnote.com/blog/best-holiday-gifts-for-clients) for more inspiration.


****


### Is it appropriate to send Thanksgiving gifts to remote employees?


Absolutely! Sending Thanksgiving gifts to remote employees is a thoughtful way to help everyone feel included and appreciated, regardless of location. Consider practical items like insulated drinkware, tech accessories, cozy apparel, or gourmet snack boxes. Direct-to-recipient shipping makes it easier to recognize employees working from home or across multiple locations.


****


### What is a good Thanksgiving gift for coworkers?


Thoughtful Thanksgiving gifts for coworkers don't have to be expensive. Gourmet chocolates, specialty teas, cozy socks, and reusable mugs are affordable options that feel personal without going overboard. For an extra touch, pair a small gift with a handwritten note expressing appreciation for their teamwork, support, or contributions throughout the year.
